source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE for role analyst) or action approve; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90. Trusted means context sandbox with any role except analyst; a trusted change prefers review at priority 80. Action inspect in context internal prefers allow at priority 70. Role operator and context partner prefers deny at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid deny. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE for role analyst) or action approve; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers deny at priority 90.
Trusted means context sandbox with any role except analyst; a trusted change prefers review at priority 80.
Action inspect in context internal prefers allow at priority 70.
Role operator and context partner prefers deny at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == analyst)) or (event.action == approve)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == sandbox) and (event.role != analyst)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == internal)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = review priority 80, forbid label = deny

rule InspectInternal:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule OperatorPartner:
    when (event.role == operator) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {auditor, analyst}
    then prefer label = review priority 1
repairs.proposed_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.role == analyst)) or (event.action == approve)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.context == sandbox) and (event.role!= analyst)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == internal)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN and not UnknownExternal(event)
    then prefer label = deny priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = review priority 80, forbid label = deny

rule InspectInternal:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule OperatorPartner:
    when (event.role == operator) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = deny priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when event.role in {auditor, analyst, operator}
    then prefer label = review priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are review, allow, deny, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
